guides.favoredWhen: Press axes early and win level 2; never get caught by crowd control without an exit.

keyTips.text: You are his permaban. He fears your axes, so force the lane on your terms from level 1 instead of letting him set a safe short-trade lane.
You are useless once crowd controlled. Track their engage cooldowns and force fights only with an exit ready — never walk in blind.
Win the level-2 race with your support. The first engage decides who holds the wave for the next minutes.

early-lane.text: Jhin loads his fourth shot on a minion and holds it to zone you off the wave. Trade while it is spent and give ground while it is held.
Deadly Flourish is a follow-up for support crowd control, not dry poke. A wasted W is your window to walk up.

win-condition.text: A landed Deadly Flourish sets up a guaranteed first Curtain Call shot when fired instantly. Break vision lines and stay mobile once it connects.

tips.text: Make him answer your shove. A Jhin stuck catching waves under his tower cannot hold the short-trade lane he wants.
Trade while his fourth shot is spent and respect it while held. The loaded shot zones you off the wave even without firing.
Walk up when he wastes Deadly Flourish ({cd:202:W}) dry. Without the follow-up root he has no answer to your axes.
Meet his objective groups and force the fight. His W-plus-R plan needs range and setup; your axes inside it win.
Sweep the objective flanks for his traps and fog picks. Denied vision denies his casts, and he cannot set up what he cannot see.
Close before his scaling erases the axe gap. Convert every kill into towers and dragons rather than sitting on a farm lead.
Break vision and stay mobile once his root connects. The instant Curtain Call shot after it is guaranteed unless you are already moving.

itemization.text: Build to duel. Your win is the straight fight he refuses, so spend for axe damage rather than poke.

keyTips.text: Keep Spinning Axes spinning and catch every return, holding up to two axes at once.
Punish the enemy marksman with W plus two axe hits around cannon minions, then freeze when the pressure forces them back.
Cash banked Adoration stacks through champion kills and avoid risky deaths before the likely payout.

tips.text: Steer axes by moving toward the wanted spot just before an attack lands, drilling one axe first and then two.
Press S to stop on a marker for tighter placement and a controlled next attack, especially near towers and in teamfights.
Force the back-or-starve choice with health pressure: freeze the wave when the opponent backs, or threaten kills when they stay to farm.
Run the Double Moon engage by hitting a minion with Q, stopping to catch, then W-ing on the next marker so the catch refreshes W for the chase.
Run Sleight of Hand from a passive farm by casting E onto the opponent while walking to a marker, then pursuing on the refreshed W through the wave.
Trade simply with auto, E, auto to fold Stand Aside into an axe exchange.
Drill Q-only last-hitting toward 100 CS by 10 minutes with no items as the axe-control benchmark.
When early pressure fails or the support matchup gives little, farm on and guard Adoration stacks instead of forcing bad fights.
Remember that death halves Adoration stacks while kills convert them to gold.
While behind, farm toward one high-value fight and cash stored stacks on a high-bounty takedown.
Turn lane damage and clean catches into a takedown so stored Adoration becomes bonus gold.
Keep catches reliable in fights, stopping with S when useful to preselect the next target first.
Aim Whirling Death at a valuable target whose return finishes them, securing the return on a high-gold enemy.
Break up a pursuer with Stand Aside, then resume speed and attack rate with Blood Rush after an axe catch.

itemization.text: Run Conqueror with Triumph, Legend: Alacrity, and Coup de Grace, plus Absolute Focus and Gathering Storm.
Build Vampiric Scepter into Berserker's Greaves, The Collector, Bloodthirster, Lord Dominik's Regards, and Infinity Edge.
Rush Vampiric Scepter and Greaves for comfort, treat a first-back Serrated Dirk as another good-feeling option, and never open Infinity Edge.
